# NEXT_ACTION — 2026-09-28-1725-total-ui-repair

## Single next action

**P0 boot repair (02 §0, 06 P0):** read `critical-boot.js`, `ikar-stable.js`,
and `ikar-first.js` IN FULL, trace every consumer of their exports, then
rewrite the complete files so `bootIkarFirst` is a callable function through
the chain and `semantic` is in the document before first-light paint.

Then: restart `node index` on 8080 (no watcher — restart is mandatory) and
verify `/heichelos/ikar` paints `#heichel-boot-title` and the discovery list
from the semantic model, with the title rendered from the API payload
(GET /api/social/heichelos/ikar → "The Entire Torah"), never a literal.

Nothing else starts until `/heichelos/ikar` renders. This is the mission gate.
Do not deploy from the dirty shared worktree — all repair work happens in it,
release happens later from a clean isolated worktree (06 P6).
